text:
anya: Quick sync — final checklist for tomorrow's webinar launch post and benchmark narrative. Main ask: SEO preflight + inbound routing. Short thread, please flag blockers.

sophie: I'll own redirect sweep and schema snippet. Where to put JSON-LD? landing page or global template?

anya: put event JSON-LD in landing page header + structured data for speaker list. keep it canonical.

matt: I'll run keyword gap vs competitors and drop 5 high-intent keywords into H1/H2 variants. Will send list by EOD. Also reminder: canonical tags for archived blog posts.

raj: inbound routing: map webinar registrants -> nurture flow A if utm_source=webinar, else B. Will set up in Marketo. Need final slug/redirects.

olivia: Can we avoid indexing thank-you page? add noindex to /thanks and use link rel=canonical to main content. Also add event attendance schema on /dashboard for registrants.

sophie: Redirect rules I'm planning:
```
# nginx
location = /old-webinar-page {
  return 301 /webinar/2026-live;
}
```
and a 1-week cache purge after switch.

seo-bot: SERP baseline report generated: impressions last 30d: 4800, avg pos 8.9. URL:/blog/launch-notes anchor test. Link: https://dash.seo/176444/base

matt: benchmark narrative: include control KPIs (CTRs, time on page, signup conversion), A/B note for headline. I'll draft.

raj: tagging: ensure gclid & utm params persist through redirect. Use JS snippet we discussed to preserve params.

olivia: small ask — internal linking plan: from docs + product pages add 3 contextual links to webinar landing, use keyword-rich anchor text (no over-optimization).

sophie: schema snippet for event (I pasted):
```
{
"@context":"https://schema.org",
"@type":"Event",
"name":"Redwood Inference: Launch Webinar",
"startDate":"2026-03-24T16:00:00Z"
}
```

anya: Thanks — action items: @sophie redirects + schema, @matt keywords + benchmark draft, @raj routing + params, @olivia internal link pass. Ping here when done. :rocket:

deploy-bot: Redirect rule submitted to staging for review — PR #432. Status: pending review.
